title: McMoneagle's JPL correspondence and life on Mars as an open secret

tellings.quote: he's basically implying to me that it's an open secret at Jet Propulsion Lab that there was life on Mars

plain: It is an open secret at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena that there was once life on Mars, according to what Joe McMoneagle is said to have told Michels in their exchanges. Michels says McMoneagle was "basically implying" this to him rather than stating it outright, and he raises it in an episode with the physicist John Brandenburg about life on Mars.
